subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the 36-year-old male executive chef from <Picture 2>, preserving his facial identity, short black hair, deep-set eyes, square jaw, the faint scar on his left brow ridge, a white heavy twill chef jacket with frayed oily cuffs, a navy coarse-weave apron with mud stains at the hem, and an old 4cm knife scar on the inner left wrist. The apron is plain navy coarse weave, no logo, no embroidery, no printed pattern, and stains appear only at the hem.
<Subject 2> is the professional hotel kitchen pass station from <Picture 9>: a stainless steel counter with fine scratches, a double-burner stove, a pass window to the north, a wall-mounted knife rack, stainless condiment canisters, a small stainless hand-wash sink at the left end of the counter with a gooseneck tap, a white cotton hand towel hanging on a rail to the right of the sink, a stainless utensil crock standing on the counter to the left of the stove holding three long-handled stainless ladles upright with the bowl down and the stem up, and non-slip floor tiles with scattered water. The walls are clad in small white square ceramic tiles with crisp dark grout lines, the floor is gray terrazzo, and the only ceiling light is warm pendant lamps.
<Subject 3> is the stainless steel stockpot from <Picture 17>: a 40cm mouth, 45cm tall, riveted side handles, a ring of white residue along the rim, and a scorched yellow patch on the lower body. The steel is dull and matte, never mirror-polished.
summary:
[reference generation] A late-evening five-star hotel kitchen. <Subject 1> washes and dries his hands, lifts the pot lid clear of the steam, draws a ladle from the utensil crock, blows on the broth, and tastes it. 9:16 vertical framing, realistic live-action Chinese drama, cold base light with warm stove fire from below.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in both shots): fully_preserved - retain his facial identity, chef jacket, apron, wrist scar, and the unhurried economy of his movements.
<Subject 2> (appears in both shots): fully_preserved - retain the counter, stove, pass window, knife rack, hand-wash sink and towel rail, the utensil crock with its three upright ladles, and light direction.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - retain the pot proportion, riveted handles, rim residue, and lid.
detailed_description:
Preserve the exact facial identity of every Subject from its Picture: identical bone structure, identical eye shape and brow line, no beauty retouching, no skin smoothing, no face reshaping. Realistic live-action Chinese drama, 9:16 vertical, studio-grade night kitchen, skin with visible pores and fine texture, soft directional light throughout, contrast ratio kept between 1:3 and 1:4, light kept motivated by the stove fire and the overhead work lamps, no image smoothing.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up from behind his shoulder at the hand-wash sink at the left end of the counter, vertical, his head and shoulder in the left third. The gooseneck tap is already running and <Subject 1>'s hands are already under the water. <Subject 1> rubs palm over palm for a beat, then presses the tap lever shut with the back of his left hand. He shakes the water off once. His right hand takes a corner of the white towel off the rail hook, he wipes both palms dry in two passes, and he hangs the towel back on the same hook. His back stays to camera throughout. Finish by approximately 00:03.600.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.900, the camera cuts to a medium shot at a 45-degree side angle on the stove side, the counter filling the lower half. <Subject 1> crosses two paces to the stove. His right hand closes over the bridge handle at the centre of the lid and lifts it straight up, and he tips his head back and away as the steam climbs past his face. He turns the lid over in his hand and sets it down inverted on the counter at his right. He turns half a step toward the crock on his left; his left hand takes the stem of one ladle, draws it up out of the crock, and rolls his wrist outward so the bowl swings from pointing down to pointing up. He lowers the bowl into the stock from the left side of the pot, lifts it clear, taps the stem once against the pot rim to shed the drip, and raises the ladle to chest height. He blows across the surface twice and takes a small sip from the edge. He holds still; his brow eases. The stove fire burns at frame edge, warm orange 3600K against a 5000K cold base. Finish by approximately 00:13.000.
overall_soundscape:
Running water, the tap lever clicking shut, water shaken off wet hands, a towel lifted off a hook and rubbed across cotton, two footsteps on wet tile, a lid lifted off a steel pot, the lid turned over and set down inverted on steel, a ladle drawn up out of a metal crock, the ladle knocked once against the pot rim, two soft blows across the broth, one small sip, and a thin extractor hum above everything. Generate these physical sounds independently; no music.
